result.topic_en: Gauss parametrises an ellipse in complex form, T = x + iy, as an odd power series in t = cos φ + i sin φ whose coefficients are polynomials in k = (aa−bb)/(2(aa+bb)); he computes the coefficients of T and TT and the first terms of the inverse series t in powers of T.
result.transcription:
176
Es sein $x, y$ indef. die Coordinaten der Puncte einer Ellipse, deren Halbaxen $= a, b$ und $x + iy$ [-= ...-] $= T$ ferner
$\frac{aa-bb}{2(aa+bb)} = k$
Es sei ferner $t$ function eines unbest. Winkels $= \cos\varphi + i\sin\varphi$;
Man soll $T$ in die form [-$At + Bt$-] $\cdot\, t + At^3 + Bt^5 + Ct^7$ bringen.
Setzt man $x - iy = T'$, so wird
$T' = t^{-1} + At^{-3} + Bt^{-5} + Ct^{-7} \ldots$
und die Coefficienten werden bestimmt durch die Gl.
$k(TT + T'T') = TT' - \frac{2aabb}{aa+bb}$ [?]
Es findet sich
$T = t$
$+t^3(k - 2k^3 + 3k^5 - k^7$ [-...-]

methods.what: Definition of the ellipse parameter k from the semi-axes
Complex parametrisation of the ellipse as an odd power series in t on the unit circle, with conjugate series in negative powers
Ellipse equation in terms of T = x+iy and T' = x−iy, used to determine the coefficients
Coefficients of the series for T as polynomials in k
Series expansion of TT in powers of t with coefficients polynomial in k (leading coefficients Catalan numbers)
Inversion of the series: t as a power series in T, in terms of k
Inverse series t in powers of T expressed in an alternative parameter λ
